items.title: Observing AWS Lambda durable functions with the Durable Execution Telemetry Exporter
items.summary: Durable functions span many Lambda invocations, so per-invocation logs answer the wrong question. The Durable Execution Telemetry Exporter is an SDK plugin that emits one complete record per execution to any of 13 destinations with a one-line change, and a companion MCP server lets an AI agent query that data in plain language.
items.creator: Pooya Paridel
